versions.content: {DRAFT} If  time recording for Time Validation is enabled for a Time Domain (refer to [ SWS_ FrTSyn_00096 ] and [ SWS_FrTSyn_00097 ] ) and  FrTSyn is configured as Time Slave for that Time Domain, FrTSyn shall call StbM_FrSetSlaveTimingData() upon successful reception of a SYNC message (refer to Figure 5 ). StbM_FrSetSlaveTimingData() shall be called after StbM_BusSetGlobalTime() .

If  time recording for Time Validation is enabled for a Time Domain (refer to [ SWS_ FrTSyn_00096 ] and [ SWS_FrTSyn_00097 ] ) and  FrTSyn is configured as Time Slave for that Time Domain, FrTSyn shall call StbM_FrSetSlaveTimingData() upon successful reception of a SYNC message (refer to Figure 5 ). StbM_FrSetSlaveTimingData() shall be called after StbM_BusSetGlobalTime() .

If • time recording for Time Validation is enabled for a Time Domain (refer to [SWS_FrTSyn_00096] and [SWS_FrTSyn_00097]) and • FrTSyn is configured as Time Slave for that Time Domain, FrTSyn shall call StbM_FrSetSlaveTimingData upon successful reception of a SYNC message. StbM_FrSetSlaveTimingData shall be called after StbM_BusSetGlobalTime .
